target.title: Causal Mask Prefix Invariance: A Test-Based Audit Fixture

tested: prefix invariance of the correct causal mask (causal_ok)
prefix invariance of the broken no-mask variant (causal_broken), expected to fail
the presence of a concrete counterexample (position and output delta) for the broken variant
not_tested: correctness of attention for inputs other than the fixed fixture input
training dynamics, model quality, or any claim beyond prefix invariance
a formal proof over all inputs (the z3_demo symbolic check is a separate fixture)
anything outside the two claims listed below

claims.text: With the correct causal mask, replacing the suffix tokens of the fixture input leaves the prefix hidden states unchanged (prefix invariance).
DETECTOR SELF-TEST: the broken variant that drops the future mask still preserves prefix invariance and must be REFUTED by the audit with a concrete counterexample.
